## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; confirmation: clear sector mix with Energy/Financials/Healthcare showing strength while Technology and Materials lag, and leadership is concentrated in Energy. Major megacap divergences (AAPL, MSFT, AMZN, TSLA) further support a restrained NEUTRAL call.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: PSX (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +17.23%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +8.85% | 1M: +16.14%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +8.07% | 1M: +12.16%) ABOVE TREND. Financials/Payments showing strength: CME (1W: +4.71% | 1M: +10.78%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +2.29% | 1M: +4.91%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Materials weak: SHW (1W: -5.25% | 1M: +6.70%) CORRECTION, CRH (1W: -7.57% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND. Technology showing internal strain with several large caps in CORRECTION or BELOW TREND: META (1W: -9.26% | 1M: -15.82%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -8.67% | 1M: +0.49%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PSX (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +17.23%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +8.85% | 1M: +16.14%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +8.07% | 1M: +12.16%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +5.65% | 1M: +7.68%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +5.30% | 1M: +6.90%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy) — cyclical/energy concentration.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: SHW (1W: -5.25% | 1M: +6.70%) CORRECTION, CHTR (1W: -5.92% | 1M: +14.86%) CORRECTION, ETN (1W: -6.09% | 1M: +7.72%) CORRECTION, ROST (1W: -6.13% | 1M: +1.57%) CORRECTION, NOW (1W: -6.31% | 1M: +14.13%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in mixed cyclicals and select tech names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: PSX (1W: +9.10%), MPC (1W: +8.85%), VLO (1W: +8.07%). Watch VTR (1W: +4.88% | 1M: -4.04%) RECOVERY and AAPL (1W: +1.68% | 1M: -4.99%) RECOVERY as potential short-term reversals; note MAJOR divergence among AAPL, MSFT, AMZN, TSLA — tactical risk, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed-to-weak with large-cap dispersion: NVDA (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +8.10%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +1.68% | 1M: -4.99%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: -4.40% | 1M: +19.72%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -9.26% | 1M: -15.82%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -1.94% | 1M: +6.61% (24 stocks) — internal rotation, watch mega-cap leadership.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Constructive: JPM (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +7.19%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.39% | 1M: +1.21%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +2.29% | 1M: +4.91%) ABOVE TREND, CME (1W: +4.71% | 1M: +10.78%) ABOVE TREND. Sector 1W: +0.96% | 1M: +3.80% (20 stocks) — steady internals supporting risk-near positioning within NEUTRAL.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Generally positive but mixed: JNJ (1W: +4.35% | 1M: +8.96%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +7.03%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +12.03%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -2.05% | 1M: -6.55%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: +1.00% | 1M: +6.19% (17 stocks) — select defensive names showing strength amid idiosyncratic headlines.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Energy and select Financials given concentrated leadership, and reduce exposure to the weakest large-cap tech names showing structural weakness (META, AVGO) while monitoring RECOVERY candidates (AAPL, VTR). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt within a NEUTRAL regime; maintain selectivity due to major megacap divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: PSX (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +17.23%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +8.85% | 1M: +16.14%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +5.65% | 1M: +7.68%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: META (1W: -9.26% | 1M: -15.82%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -8.67% | 1M: +0.49%) CORRECTION, NOW (1W: -6.31% | 1M: +14.13%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.66% | 1M: +10.89%) — leadership and momentum. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.94% | 1M: +6.61%) and Materials (1W: -3.04% | 1M: +5.15%) — watch for spillover if megacap weakness continues.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +8.10%) ABOVE TREND — monitor 650–700 area for continuation/rotation signals. AAPL (1W: +1.68% | 1M: -4.99%) RECOVERY — watch 170–180 support zone for follow-through. PSX (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +17.23%) ABOVE TREND — break above recent highs confirms energy leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
GILD (+60): Major court ruling cited; GILD (1W: +5.65% | 1M: +7.68%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. PFE (+55): EMA Lyme filing validation; PFE (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +12.03%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. AMZN (+55): AI business update; AMZN (1W: -4.71% | 1M: +3.78%) CORRECTION — positive headlines but price is weakening (divergence).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
META (-45): Child-safety trial headlines; META (1W: -9.26% | 1M: -15.82%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and elevated risk. AAPL (-45): App Store revenue concerns; AAPL (1W: +1.68% | 1M: -4.99%) RECOVERY — negative headlines but short-term price bounce (divergence). UNH (-50): IRS scrutiny headlines; UNH (1W: -2.05% | 1M: -6.55%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Value/Cyclical style. PSX (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +17.23%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +8.85% | 1M: +16.14%) ABOVE TREND and GILD (1W: +5.65% | 1M: +7.68%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major megacap divergences (AAPL, MSFT, AMZN, TSLA) and concentrated Energy leadership mean tactical selectivity is warranted.
